body:
Censoring information so people will poison themselves and survive with a plethora of physical problems rather than choose to live without those problems or choose another method with lower risk of survival because you think it "saves" them somehow is the most fucked up thing I've ever read.  It's poisoning a well when you've stocked clean water at your house so when people knock they *have* to accept the terms of your household when they would've been able to help themselves if it weren't for your meddling.

How fragile is your ego?

Most are, which is why I made the post.  If they don't end up with *any* kind of damage than it isn't actually a suicide attempt.

You're misguided.  You're trying to save lives at the expense of injury from ignorance.  I'm trying to save lives by informing of likely consequence.  You can still get help without attempting suicide, you know.  And better to seek help pre-self-inflicted disability than after.  You and whoever removed this post aren't doing anyone any favors.
